text:
A lie. I did it just to deceive,
+and nothing more. That’s that. Otherwise,
+you too will see
+how much it will hurt me to have been this way.
+
+A lie. Be quiet.
+That’s enough.
+Since other times you do this same thing to me,
+that is why I too have been this way.
+
+Me, who had watched so very closely to see whether
+you truly cried,
+since other times you merely remained
+in your sweet little pouts;
+me, who never dreamed you would believe them—
+your tears got the better of me.
+That’s that.
+
+But now you know: it was all a lie.
+And if you keep on crying, well then!
+Next time I will not even look when you play.

translation.title: Trilce: Poem LI — A Lie. I Did It Just to Deceive
translation.editorial_note: The childlike quarrel is kept plain and breathlessly defensive; pucheros remains little pouts, holding together the face, staged tears, and diminutive tenderness.
